            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        }
        .header .logo {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--doge-gold), var(--doge-orange));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
        }
        .header .logo .version {
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.08);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            font-size: 0.35rem;
            padding: 1px 8px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.1);
        }
        .header .badge-ultimate {
            border: 1px solid var(--doge-gold);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.08);
            padding: 2px 12px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .header .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .header .nav-links a {
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .header .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--text);
            border-color: var(--border);
        }
        .header .nav-links a.gold {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            border-color: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.1);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.05);
        }
        .header .price-box {
            text-align: right;
            min-width: 120px;
        }
        .header .price-box .price {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }
        .header .price-box .price.green {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .header .price-box .price.red {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .header .price-box .change {
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .balance-display {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.06);
            padding: 4px 16px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.08);
        }
        .clock-display {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--musk-blue);
            background: rgba(0, 180, 216, 0.06);
            padding: 2px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 180, 216, 0.08);
        }

        /* ─── HERO STATS ─── */
        .hero-stats {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(90px, 1fr));
            gap: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            padding: 10px 16px;
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .hero-stats .stat-item {
            text-align: center;
        }
        .hero-stats .stat-item .num {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            display: block;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        .hero-stats .stat-item .num.green {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .hero-stats .stat-item .num.gold {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .hero-stats .stat-item .num.red {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .hero-stats .stat-item .num.blue {
            color: var(--musk-blue);
        }
        .hero-stats .stat-item .label {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* ─── STATUS BAR ─── */
        .status-bar {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 4px 14px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 3px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
        }
        .status-bar .live {
            color: #00ff88;
            font-weight: 700;
            animation: pulse 1.2s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulse {
            0%,
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 0.3;
            }
        }
        .status-bar .regime-tag {
            padding: 1px 10px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
        }
        .status-bar .regime-tag.trending {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08);
            color: #00ff88;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08);
        }
        .status-bar .regime-tag.ranging {
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.08);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.08);
        }
        .status-bar .regime-tag.volatile {
            background: rgba(235, 87, 87, 0.08);
            color: var(--doge-red);
            border: 1px solid rgba(235, 87, 87, 0.08);
        }

        /* ─── CHART ─── */
        .chart-wrap {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .chart-wrap .chart-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }
        .chart-wrap .chart-header h3 {
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .chart-wrap .chart-header .chart-tools {
            display: flex;
            gap: 3px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .chart-wrap .chart-header .chart-tools button {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            padding: 1px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.35rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .chart-wrap .chart-header .chart-tools button:hover {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .chart-wrap .chart-header .chart-tools button.active {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.05);
        }

        .timeframe-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .timeframe-buttons button {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            padding: 1px 5px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: 0.35rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .timeframe-buttons button.active {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.05);
        }

        #candleCanvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 240px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            display: block;
            touch-action: none;
            cursor: crosshair;
            background: transparent;
        }
        #volumeCanvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            display: block;
            margin-top: 2px;
            background: transparent;
        }
        #indicatorCanvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 80px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            display: block;
            margin-top: 2px;
            background: transparent;
        }
        #equityCanvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            display: block;
            margin-top: 4px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        }

        .fib-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            padding: 4px 2px 0 2px;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .fib-bar .level {
            padding: 1px 10px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.02);
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.04);
        }
        .fib-bar .level .val {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .alert-input {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }
        .alert-input input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            outline: none;
            transition: var(--transition);
            min-width: 60px;
        }
        .alert-input input:focus {
            border-color: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.25);
        }
        .alert-input button {
            padding: 4px 12px;
            background: var(--doge-gold);
            color: #0a0e17;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .alert-input button:hover {
            background: #f0c800;
        }

        /* ─── ORDER BOOK ─── */
        .order-book {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 6px 12px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 2px 12px;
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .order-book .ob-header {
            grid-column: 1/-1;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding-bottom: 4px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .order-book .ob-side .ob-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 1px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
        }
        .order-book .ob-side .ob-item.ask .ob-price {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .order-book .ob-side .ob-item.bid .ob-price {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .order-book .ob-spread {
            grid-column: 1/-1;
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            padding-top: 4px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .order-book .ob-spread .spread-val {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* ─── TRADE PANEL ─── */
        .trade-panel {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 6px;
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .trade-panel .full {
            grid-column: 1/-1;
        }
        .trade-panel label {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .trade-panel input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 5px 10px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            outline: none;
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row {
            grid-column: 1/-1;
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row button {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 10px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
            min-width: 50px;
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-buy {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88, #00cc66);
            color: #0a0e17;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-buy:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.3);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-sell {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--doge-red), #cc0044);
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(235, 87, 87, 0.15);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-sell:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(235, 87, 87, 0.3);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-close {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            color: var(--text);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-close:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-oco {
            background: rgba(0, 180, 216, 0.08);
            color: var(--musk-blue);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 180, 216, 0.12);
        }
        .trade-panel .btn-row .btn-oco:hover {
            background: rgba(0, 180, 216, 0.15);
        }
        .trade-panel .risk-row {
            grid-column: 1/-1;
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .trade-panel .risk-row input[type="range"] {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 60px;
            accent-color: var(--doge-gold);
            height: 3px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .trade-panel .risk-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            appearance: none;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--doge-gold);
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.3);
        }
        .trade-panel .risk-row .risk-val {
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 20px;
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row {
            grid-column: 1/-1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row input[type="range"] {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 80px;
            accent-color: var(--doge-gold);
            height: 3px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            max: 150;
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            appearance: none;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--doge-gold);
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row .lev-val {
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 40px;
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .trade-panel .leverage-row input[type="number"] {
            width: 60px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text);
            padding: 2px 4px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            text-align: center;
        }

        /* ─── POSITION BOX ─── */
        .position-box {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 8px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 4px 16px;
            align-items: center;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .position-box .pos-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }
        .position-box .pos-label {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .position-box .pos-value {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .position-box .pos-value.green {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .position-box .pos-value.red {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .position-box .pos-value.gold {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .position-box .pos-value.small {
            font-size: 0.6rem;
        }
        .position-box .pos-trailing {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .position-box .pos-trailing input[type="checkbox"] {
            accent-color: var(--doge-gold);
        }

        /* ─── PENDING ORDERS ─── */
        .pending-orders {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 8px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .pending-orders .po-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .pending-orders .po-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 3px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .pending-orders .po-item .po-type.limit {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .pending-orders .po-item .po-type.stop {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .pending-orders .po-item .po-type.oco {
            color: var(--musk-blue);
        }
        .pending-orders .po-item .po-cancel {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--doge-red);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            padding: 0 4px;
        }

        /* ─── SIDEBAR ─── */
        .hamburger {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 4px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: none;
            background: transparent;
        }
        .hamburger span {
            width: 20px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--text-dim);
            transition: var(--transition);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(4px, 4px);
        }
        .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }
        .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(4px, -4px);
        }
        .hamburger:hover span {
            background: var(--text);
        }

        .sidebar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            right: -340px;
            width: 320px;
            height: 100vh;
            background: rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.98);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 24px 18px;
            transition: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            z-index: 1000;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .sidebar.open {
            right: 0;
        }
        .sidebar h4 {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .sidebar .menu-item {
            padding: 8px 14px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text);
            border: 1px solid transparent;
        }
        .sidebar .menu-item:hover {
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.04);
            border-color: var(--border);
        }
        .sidebar .menu-item .icon {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }
        .sidebar-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            z-index: 999;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: 0.4s;
        }
        .sidebar-overlay.active {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        /* ─── JOURNAL ─── */
        .journal-form {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .journal-form .form-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .journal-form .full {
            grid-column: 1/-1;
        }
        .journal-form label {
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .journal-form input,
        .journal-form select,
        .journal-form textarea {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            outline: none;
        }
        .journal-form textarea {
            resize: vertical;
            min-height: 30px;
        }
        .journal-form .btn-save {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 8px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--doge-gold), var(--doge-orange));
            color: #0a0e17;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .journal-entry {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 6px 12px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            position: relative;
        }
        .journal-entry .je-head {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 2px;
        }
        .journal-entry .je-head .pair {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
        }
        .journal-entry .je-head .dir.buy {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .journal-entry .je-head .dir.sell {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .journal-entry .je-head .result.win {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .journal-entry .je-head .result.loss {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .journal-entry .je-head .result.be {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .journal-entry .je-del {
            position: absolute;
            top: 2px;
            right: 6px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .journal-entry .je-del:hover {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .journal-entry .je-note {
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            padding-top: 2px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
        }

        /* ─── HISTORY ─── */
        .trade-history .th-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 4px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 2px;
        }
        .trade-history .th-item .th-pl.green {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .trade-history .th-item .th-pl.red {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .trade-history .th-item .th-pl.gold {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .trade-history .th-empty {
            padding: 16px;
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
        }

        /* ─── ANALYTICS ─── */
        .analytics-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(70px, 1fr));
            gap: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .analytics-grid .a-item {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 6px 4px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .analytics-grid .a-item .a-val {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            display: block;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        .analytics-grid .a-item .a-val.green {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .analytics-grid .a-item .a-val.red {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .analytics-grid .a-item .a-val.gold {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .analytics-grid .a-item .a-val.blue {
            color: var(--musk-blue);
        }
        .analytics-grid .a-item .a-label {
            font-size: 0.35rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* ─── ACHIEVEMENTS ─── */
        .achievement-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 10px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin: 2px;
            border: 1px solid var(--doge-gold);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.06);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .achievement-badge.unlocked {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.06);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .achievement-badge.locked {
            border-color: var(--text-dim);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            background: transparent;
        }

        /* ─── SETTINGS ─── */
        .settings-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .settings-grid .full {
            grid-column: 1/-1;
        }
        .settings-grid label {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .settings-grid input,
        .settings-grid select {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            outline: none;
        }
        .settings-grid .btn-reset {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 6px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--doge-red), #cc0044);
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            font-weight: 900;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .settings-grid .btn-reset:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(235, 87, 87, 0.2);
        }

        /* ─── TOAST ─── */
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 80px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100px);
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 6px 20px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            z-index: 9999;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            max-width: 92%;
        }
        .toast.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
        .toast.success {
            border-color: #00ff88;
        }
        .toast.error {
            border-color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .toast.gold {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
        }

        /* ─── DOPAMINE ─── */
        .dopamine-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 99999;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .dopamine-overlay .confetti-piece {
            position: absolute;
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            animation: confettiFall linear forwards;
        }
        @keyframes confettiFall {
            0% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(-20px) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(100vh) rotate(720deg) scale(0.3);
            }
        }
        .dopamine-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: -100px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: var(--card);
            border: 2px solid var(--doge-gold);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 12px 28px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.06);
            z-index: 99998;
            text-align: center;
            transition: top 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            max-width: 92%;
        }
        .dopamine-banner.show {
            top: 20px;
        }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-icon {
            font-size: 2rem;
            display: block;
        }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 900;
        }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.green {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.red {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-sub {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-streak {
            display: inline-block;
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.12);
            padding: 1px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }

        /* ─── PWA INSTALL ─── */
        .pwa-install-banner {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 20px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--doge-gold);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 12px 24px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            z-index: 99999;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.05);
        }
        .pwa-install-banner.show {
            display: flex;
        }
        .pwa-install-banner .pwa-close {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        /* ─── TABS ─── */
        .tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .tabs .tab-btn {
            padding: 6px 16px;
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .tabs .tab-btn.active {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.05);
        }
        .tabs .tab-btn:hover {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .tab-content {
            display: none;
        }
        .tab-content.active {
            display: block;
        }

        /* ─── TIMELINE ─── */
        .tab-timeline {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 12px;
            margin: 8px 0;
            max-height: 600px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .timeline-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 10px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.05);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .timeline-item:hover {
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.03);
            padding-left: 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
        }
        .timeline-year {
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            min-width: 50px;
        }
        .timeline-event {
            flex: 1;
            margin: 0 10px;
        }
        .timeline-event .title {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
        }
        .timeline-event .desc {
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .timeline-price {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
        }
        .timeline-price.up {
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .timeline-price.down {
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }

        /* ─── ELON FEED ─── */
        .elon-feed-panel {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-header .x-profile {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-header .x-profile .x-avatar {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.2);
            border: 2px solid var(--doge-gold);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-header .x-profile .x-name {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-header .x-profile .x-handle {
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-header .x-status {
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-header .x-status .x-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #00ff88;
            animation: pulse 1.2s infinite;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-feed {
            max-height: 200px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-top: 6px;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-feed .x-tweet {
            padding: 4px 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-feed .x-tweet .x-tweet-sig {
            padding: 0 8px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            margin-left: 3px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-feed .x-tweet .x-tweet-sig.long {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-feed .x-tweet .x-tweet-sig.short {
            background: rgba(235, 87, 87, 0.2);
            color: var(--doge-red);
        }
        .elon-feed-panel .x-feed .x-tweet .x-tweet-time {
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            margin-left: auto;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* ─── SETUP LIBRARY ─── */
        .setup-library {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .setup-card {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 12px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
            cursor: default;
        }
        .setup-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            transform: scale(1.02);
        }
        .setup-card h5 {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            font-weight: 900;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }
        .setup-card p {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        /* ─── MUSK MENTOR ─── */
        .mentor-bubble {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--musk-blue);
            border-radius: 18px;
            padding: 14px 18px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .mentor-bubble::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -8px;
            left: 20px;
            border-left: 8px solid transparent;
            border-right: 8px solid transparent;
            border-bottom: 8px solid var(--musk-blue);
        }
        .mentor-bubble .mentor-name {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--musk-blue);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
        }
        .mentor-bubble .mentor-text {
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            margin-top: 4px;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ─── SCANNER ─── */
        .scanner-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 2px 0;
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
        }
        .scanner-item .scanner-pattern {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .scanner-item .scanner-tf {
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        /* ─── FOOTER ─── */
        .footer-musk {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 20px;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        .footer-musk strong {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }
        .footer-musk .sig {
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            font-style: italic;
        }
        .chart-msg-musk {
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.1);
            padding: 6px 16px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            margin: 4px 0;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .chart-msg-musk span {
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }

        /* ─── QUICK TRADE ─── */
        .quick-trade-btn {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .quick-trade-btn.risk-1 {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
            color: #00ff88;
        }
        .quick-trade-btn.risk-2 {
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.15);
            color: #f2c94c;
        }
        .quick-trade-btn.risk-5 {
            background: rgba(235, 87, 87, 0.15);
            color: #eb5757;
        }
        .quick-trade-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        /* ─── INDICATOR TOGGLE ─── */
        .indicator-toggle {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            padding: 1px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.35rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .indicator-toggle.active {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
            background: rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.05);
        }
        .indicator-toggle:hover {
            border-color: var(--doge-gold);
            color: var(--doge-gold);
        }

        /* ─── MEDIA ─── */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            #candleCanvas {
                height: 180px;
            }
            #volumeCanvas {
                height: 30px;
            }
            #indicatorCanvas {
                height: 50px;
            }
            .analytics-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            }
            .hero-stats {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            }
            .trade-panel .btn-row button {
                font-size: 0.65rem;
                padding: 8px;
            }
            .sidebar {
                width: 280px;
                right: -300px;
            }
            .header .logo {
                font-size: 0.9rem;
            }
            .setup-library {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }
            .dopamine-banner {
                padding: 10px 16px;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 380px) {
            #candleCanvas {
                height: 140px;
            }
            #volumeCanvas {
                height: 25px;
            }
            #indicatorCanvas {
                height: 40px;
            }
            .hero-stats {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }
            .analytics-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }
            .setup-library {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
